verses.arabicText: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.englishText: Qāf.[1524] By the honored Qur’ān...[1525]
verses.footnotes:
[1524] See footnote to 2:1.
[1525] See footnote to 38:1.

verses.arabicText: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.englishText: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

verses.arabicText: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verses.englishText: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

verses.arabicText: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.englishText: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

verses.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.englishText: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verses.englishText: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.englishText: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

verses.arabicText: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.englishText: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

verses.arabicText: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.englishText: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

verses.arabicText: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verses.englishText: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

verses.arabicText: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.englishText: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.englishText: The people of Noah denied before them,[1526] and the companions of the well[1527] and Thamūd
verses.footnotes:
[1526] i.e., before the disbelievers of Makkah.
[1527] See footnote to 25:38.

verses.arabicText: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verses.englishText: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot

verses.arabicText: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.englishText: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

verses.arabicText: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.englishText: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.englishText: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.
verses.footnotes: [1528] In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.

verses.arabicText: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verses.englishText: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,[1529] seated on the right and on the left.
verses.footnotes: [1529] And record each word and deed.

verses.arabicText: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verses.englishText: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.englishText: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

verses.arabicText: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.englishText: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verses.englishText: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.[1530]
verses.footnotes: [1530] i.e., one angel driving the soul to the Judgement and one to testify as to its deeds.

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verses.englishText: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,[1531] so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
verses.footnotes: [1531] Of heedlessness, or that which had sealed your hearing, your vision and your heart from guidance.

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.englishText: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

verses.arabicText: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.englishText: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.arabicText: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.englishText: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.englishText: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.englishText: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.englishText: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].

verses.arabicText: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.englishText: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verses.englishText: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

verses.arabicText: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.englishText: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verses.englishText: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].

verses.arabicText: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.englishText: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

verses.arabicText: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.englishText: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

verses.arabicText: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.englishText: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.englishText: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.englishText: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.englishText: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.englishText: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.englishText: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

verses.arabicText: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.englishText: And listen on the Day when the Caller[1532] will call out from a place that is near -
verses.footnotes: [1532] An angel who will call out Allāh's command for the Resurrection.

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.englishText: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.englishText: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.englishText: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.englishText: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
verses.footnotes: [1533] Forcing people to belief or submission.
